'''Kanen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] fighting on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kanen first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the mission "The Icy Road to Victory." He was originally supposed to ask players to retrieve a holocron in the mission "Frozen In Time."
